Former NBA Player Omri Casspi's Firm Launches New Venture Capital Fund

A venture capital firm co-founded by former NBA player Omri Casspi has launched a new fund. The firm, which Casspi co-founded with Shimon Mizrahi, has raised $250 million for its latest fund, which will focus on high-tech startups. Forbes reported that Casspi's venture capital firm has built an $800 million portfolio. The Jerusalem Post identified Casspi as the first Israeli NBA player.
